Name: Lewis to Mayor Thomas Character overhaul
Author: Budzilla403
Description:
This mod changes both the portraits and sprites of Lewis to Mayor Thomas from FoMT, for those that fee like some nostalgia. 

Feel free to leave some feedback

Downloads.Description: To install it simply drop the "Content" folder into your Stardew Valley steam directory and say "yes" when it asks to replace. I have included backups for both files.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
